_doc: The fleet ROSTER: every node that can host an implementation lane. Distinct from infra/fleet-watch/peers.json, which is a watcher->watched LIVENESS map (who alarms for whom) and deliberately does NOT list every node. This file answers a different question: 'where could a lane run?'. Consumed by scripts/fleet_dispatch.py.
_repo_path: Deliberately NOT stored per node. Every node resolves the repo as "$HOME/nuzantara" ON THE TARGET MACHINE, so a hardcoded /Users/<someone>/... can never drift onto a machine with a different user (cicatrix family #1, the M5 balizero-vs-nuzantara path-drift scar). Change the layout and this file needs no edit.

nodes.name: mini
nodes.role: H24 server (Ollama, heavy cron) — usually the freest
